rationale: Starter layer configuration (Story 3.2): Sleep, from starter-recipes.md and design log 2026-10-27 (m), (n). Theta reference: a 450 Hz carrier amplitude-modulated by the sine envelope at a steady 2 Hz, 75 percent AM depth. Binaural layer: a 100 Hz pure sine in the left ear and a pure sine in the right ear whose binaural beat rate cycles sinusoidally over 0 to 3 Hz every 60 s, starting at 0 Hz and rising. No gamma PAC layer. 45 min, no loop. No fade (Epic 4). Not the Epic 6 starter recipe.
